passport_validity_rule: At least six months at entry; at least two blank pages.
return_ticket_rule: Round-trip flight reservation; do not purchase tickets before visa issuance.
proof_of_funds_rule: Proof of income: recent pay slips, bank statement or credit-card statement.
accommodation_rule: Hotel reservation and itinerary; invitation letter if no hotel reservation.
travel_insurance_rule: Not specified in reviewed general tourist-visa guidance.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: No specific health condition stated in reviewed tourist-visa guidance.
transit_rule: No Bangladesh-specific transit exemption or transit-visa rule verified.
application_channel: Contact Argentine Embassy Dhaka Visa Section for appointment; personal application and consular interview at a consular office.
application_fee: USD 150 or EUR 150; payable in local currency; Dhaka amount not published.
processing_time: Not officially specified; appointment and consular interview required.
required_documents: Ordinary passport valid at least six months at entry with two blank pages|Two current 4 x 4 cm colour photographs on a white background|Completed and signed tourist visa application form|Proof of income such as recent pay slips, bank statement or credit-card statement|Round-trip flight reservation; do not purchase tickets before visa issuance|Hotel reservation and itinerary or invitation letter|Personal consular interview|Consular fee of USD 150 or EUR 150, paid in local currency|Additional documents requested by the consular authority
official_immigration_source_name: Argentina National Directorate of Migration — Visa Regime (Ordinary Passport/Tourist)
cross_check_source_name: Argentina Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Tourist Visa
review_notes: The current National Directorate of Migration table explicitly lists Bangladesh under ordinary passport (tourist) as REQUIERE VISA. MFA tourist-visa procedure gives up to 90 days, passport valid six months with two blank pages, two current 4x4 cm colour photographs on white, signed form, proof of income, return reservation, hotel or invitation, interview and USD150/EUR150 fee paid in local currency. Dhaka Embassy publishes a Visa Section email; local fee and appointment mechanics must be confirmed. US visa/Green Card exemptions for India, Dominican Republic and China do not include Bangladesh.

maximum_permitted_stay: Up to three months (Bangladesh row in Government visa schedule; subject to admission).
passport_validity_rule: At least six months at entry.
proof_of_funds_rule: Proof of sufficient funds may be requested.
accommodation_rule: Hotel confirmation or name and address of residence.
travel_insurance_rule: Not specified in reviewed official visitor guidance.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: Yellow fever certificate required for travellers over age one arriving from listed risk countries or transiting more than 12 hours through a risk-country airport; vaccination at least 10 days before entry.
transit_rule: No Bangladesh-specific transit exemption verified in reviewed official guidance.
application_channel: No visa application; present passport and visitor-entry documents to Bahamas Immigration on arrival.
application_fee: No visitor visa fee; visa-free visitor entry.
required_documents: Ordinary passport valid at least six months at entry|Return or onward ticket|Hotel confirmation or name and address of residence|Proof of sufficient funds to support the visit if requested|Completed immigration form on arrival|Yellow fever vaccination certificate when arriving from a listed risk country or transiting more than 12 hours through a risk-country airport, if applicable|For minors, notarized parental/guardian consent where applicable; unaccompanied minors need a certified or notarized guardian letter
official_immigration_source_name: Government of The Bahamas — Visa Requirements for Foreigners Travelling to The Bahamas (file dated 28 May 2025)
cross_check_source_name: The Bahamas Official Tourism Website — Immigration & Visa Requirements
review_notes: Government visa schedule dated 28 May 2025 explicitly lists Bangladesh passport holders visa-free for three months. Official visitor guidance requires passport valid six months, return/onward ticket, accommodation details and funds if requested. Yellow fever proof applies to travellers over one arriving from listed risk countries or transiting over 12 hours through a risk-country airport; vaccination at least 10 days before entry. 2025 minor guidance may require notarized consent. This is visa-free entry, not VOA; no visa fee or separate visa photograph. Final admission remains discretionary.
